scenario.prompt: Build the widgets.json for "Vol Desk Data" at http://localhost:7801. It has exactly one entry, `vol_playbook_note`: name "Vol Playbook Note", description "Markdown playbook for the vol desk.", endpoint /vol-playbook, type markdown, sized w=12 h=8 on the grid, category "Volatility", params required: section — a text input (type text), labeled "Section", default "morning", described "Playbook section to open."; it caches results for 15 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000.. Then add the backend.
scenario.title: Compose the Vol Playbook Note content widget

notes: Write one JSON object per line.
Use only tools listed in scenario.allowed_tools.
The harness executes calls after the command exits and grades final state.
